glycerol can increase the rainfastness and efficacy of Vision® on trembling aspen.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of glycerol and the use of a high surfactant (Silwet® L-77) can improve rainfastness and increase the herbicidal activity.
the optimum spray mix for maximum herbicidal activity is Vision + 0.25 % of Silwet + 0.75 % of glycerol.
the addition of 0.15 to 0.25 percent of glycerol and 0.15 percent of Silwet® to Vision® spray mixtures provided optimum spreading, drying and rainfastness of Vision® droplets.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of glycerol and Silwet® to glyphosate formulations can significantly improve rainfastness and efficacy of the herbicide on trembling aspen.
the use of Silwet as an adjuvant to glyphosate is a good way to improve the rainfastness of the herbicide.
